spans.text:
The `origin`, `tool_call_id`, `risk`, and `categories` attributes give
the model machine-readable provenance for every byte it reads.
spans.note: The prompt explicitly enforces information provenance and integrity by requiring structural quarantine envelopes with machine-readable provenance attributes (origin, tool_call_id, risk, categories) for every byte the agent reads. It also mandates quoting rather than paraphrasing attacker-controlled text to prevent information corruption.

The prompt is fundamentally designed to prevent credential and data exfiltration. It explicitly identifies and defends against attacks that attempt to steal API keys, credentials, and sensitive data via prompt injection, including exfiltration via markdown image tags and email tool abuse.
